title: CredentialStore always runs bcrypt::verify even for unknown usernames (timing-safe)
description:
## Decision
crates/auth/src/store.rs CredentialStore::check() always calls bcrypt::verify even when the username is not found, using a precomputed dummy_hash at the same cost factor as production hashes. This prevents a timing oracle that would reveal which usernames exist (an unknown-user check would complete in microseconds vs ~100ms for bcrypt). The dummy hash is seeded from actual hash costs to remain calibrated as operators change cost factors.
